verdict.rationale: This is a professional/workstation GPU marketed for AI, data science, and content-creation workloads, not gaming; evidence mentions DisplayPort resolution/refresh capability and DLSS 4 but no gaming benchmarks (FPS, frame-time, high-refresh 4K gaming tests) either vendor-claimed or independently verified. Community discussion focuses on price, power draw, and hardware defects, not gaming performance. Missing for 10: any 4K gaming FPS benchmarks, independent game-performance reviews, or vendor gaming-specific performance claims.
